claim_legs.durability: Preserve first finding, exact capture and retained small version records, byte/identity pins, scoped disposition, task/book/Knowledge Map and commit.
claim_legs.falsification: Reject stale compiler bytes, old or substituted SDK selection, changed SDK metadata, wrong relative product source, hidden cross-volume writes and promoted historical equivalence.
claim_legs.rederivation: Exact Git-era admissions and current no-follow stable descriptor hashes, SDK symlink resolution/version metadata and OS identity.

external_access_reason: Required installed compiler, SDK selection/version/header and OS runtime dependencies for the current fixed native builder. They reside on the OS volume, are read-only inputs, and are never copied to an off-volume project cache or modified. All produced evidence stays under this repository.
qualification_scope: Current selection and bounded byte/metadata pins only. SDK dependency contents and compiler dynamic-library closure are not exhaustively attested. No compiler, xcrun, fixture, original, native proxy or collector invocation. No rollback to an old SDK, target/flag/bounds change or historical startup-cause claim.
